method.journeys: Independently seeded journeys from newGame targeting floor 400 within the unchanged simulator budget of 160000 decisions. Incomplete policy samples keep their actual floor/phase and are not replaced. Checkpoint 200 is a prefix of the same seed, never another independent journey.
method.policy: Safe events, expected-score automatic equipment choice, no shop/forge/fusion purchases; all naturally earned talent points legally allocated to power. Product rolls remain manual; the audit policy is offline.
method.capture: Active naturally reached combat at floor >=140, previously settled retaliation >0, settled HP strictly below 99% of current maximum. Per seed and 1-200 / 201-400 stratum retain the first and most recent two states; absent states remain absent.
method.branches: Keep current loadout, or highest original estimated improvement inside [-30,+30] in each available weapon/armor/relic slot; tie by item ID. No future outcome is used to pick gear. Each free equip preserves first enemy and opening RNG. Continue 12 completed battle attempts or first death, retain chosen gear, invest new points in power, claim rewards and free rest, decline events and paid services.
method.stateHashes: SHA256 of JSON.stringify({...state,runId:"date-normalized"}); every other state field is retained. Full encode/decode round trips use exact unnormalized deep equality.
method.copyScope: Conditional details and hints are retained exactly; they are explanatory UI values, not survival or actual-damage forecasts.
method.incomplete: All-roll totals include the unfinished final battle. Completed-attempt totals remain separately named. Incomplete journey codec saves and the final 64 actual rolls are retained outside the runtime. Battle branches keep the original 6000-decision ceiling and report exhaustion without replacement.

limitations: Fixed seeds and deliberately constrained offline policy are not representative human win rates or proof of optimal build balance. A bounded policy failure is reported explicitly and does not by itself establish a product bug.
Natural battle counts and battle-ending HP metrics describe completed attempts only; unfinished active combat is separately retained, and all-roll totals include it.
Gross retaliation is recorded before healing in the same legal turn; net battle-ending HP loss and below-full-HP capture are distinct measures. Neither is a count of retaliations.
A captured opening battle may already be in progress; the window is 12 completed attempts, not 12 fresh battles. Branches from a seed may overlap and are not independent random samples.
Instantaneous HP clipping after equipment replacement is reported separately as swapHpLoss; later minima can include it.
No paid choice is made in this audit. A free swap outcome cannot establish shop, forge, fusion or respec value.
The complete original inventory remains in every gameplay transition; only comparison read views use the previously audited compact adapter.
No synthetic damage/HP/enemy/room/RNG fields or retry manipulation produce the natural captures. Zero deaths does not by itself identify a bug.
